description: Read one reflow2 skill in full, by name (see list_skills) or by the slash command a person types for it ("/gaps", "gaps"). Returns the whole SKILL.md — follow it as written. Call this BEFORE the work the skill covers, not after: these describe how to do the step, not how to report it. The body always comes whole; the lessons this design holds for the step are held to `budget_chars`, and any withheld are named by id. Ask for this when you want the full playbook, procedure or step-by-step guide for a kind of task — how to do it properly, not just what exists.

budget_chars.description:
How many characters of JSON this reply may spend (default 30,000).
The skill's body always comes WHOLE; what gives is the list of lessons
this design holds for the step, ranked newest first and withheld whole
from the end. The reply then says how many it withheld, names each by
id (`lessons.withheld_ids`; read one with get_node), and keeps the
count. Raise it only if this client has the room.

name.description:
The skill's name, as `list_skills` reports it, or the slash command a
person types for it (its `shortcut`), with or without the slash.

name: get_skill
